title: Sadae Fatema Zahra
body:
ya imame zamana
<<DIVIDER>>
sada e fatema zahra baqi se aati hai
hussain e asr tujhe karbala bulaati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
lehad mein maadar e muztar ke dil ko chain aaye
mai raah takti hoon kab mera noore ain aaye
yun intezar mein har subho beet jaati hai
sadae fatema zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
jala tha jis se mere paak ghar ka darwaza
nahi hai baba ki ummat tumhe ye andaza
ye aag gumbad e khizra ko bhi jalaati hai
sadae fatema zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
padar ki yaad sataati hai jab hazeena ko
tasalli de ke meri laadli sakina ko
tumhare naam ki lori lehad sunati hai
sadae fatema zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera jari mera abbas sher e dil beta
jo karbala mein tha paband lad nahi paaya
abhi to us ke bhi hisse ke jang baaqi hai
sadae fatema zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tere zahoor mein tajeel ki dua lab par
shikasta pehlu ko thaame huwe teri maadar
azaa ke farsh pe pehle se baith jaati hai
sadae fatema zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ke naam ki barchi hai mere seene mein
behan hai jis ki abhi muntazir madine mein
nishane qabr banaati kabhi mitaati hai
sadae fatema zahra...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera hussain mera bawafa mera mohsin
sagheer qasim o akbar sakina aur hassan
mujhe ali ki bhi tanhaai yaad aati hai
sadae fatema zahra...
